```yaml
name: Nightly Apex Regression Tests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: nightly-apex-tests-qa
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  apex-tests:
    name: Run Apex tests in QA sandbox
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        run: |
          npm install --global @salesforce/cli
          sf --version

      - name: Log in to QA sandbox using JWT bearer flow
        env:
          QA_CONSUMER_KEY: ${{ secrets.QA_CONSUMER_KEY }}
          QA_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.QA_USERNAME }}
          QA_JWT_KEY: ${{ secrets.QA_JWT_KEY }}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "$QA_JWT_KEY" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/qa-jwt.key"
          chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/qa-jwt.key"
          trap 'rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/qa-jwt.key"' EXIT
          sf org login jwt --username "$QA_USERNAME" --client-id "$QA_CONSUMER_KEY" --jwt-key-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/qa-jwt.key" --instance-url https://test.salesforce.com --alias qa

      - name: Run local Apex tests with code coverage
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          sf apex run test --target-org qa --test-level RunLocalTests --code-coverage --wait 60 --result-format junit --output-dir test-results/

      - name: Upload Apex test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: apex-test-results
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Fail if any Apex test failed
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import glob
          import sys
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

          files = glob.glob("test-results/**/*.xml", recursive=True)
          if not files:
              print("No JUnit test results found in test-results/")
              sys.exit(1)

          failed = 0
          for path in files:
              try:
                  root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Could not parse JUnit results in {path}: {exc}")
                  sys.exit(1)
              for testcase in root.iter("testcase"):
                  if testcase.find("failure") is not None or testcase.find("error") is not None:
                      failed += 1
                      print(f"Failed: {testcase.get('classname', '')}.{testcase.get('name', '')}")

          if failed:
              print(f"{failed} Apex test(s) failed.")
              sys.exit(1)

          print("All Apex tests passed.")
          PY
```

File: force-app/main/default/classes/ContactEmailMatcher.cls
```apex
public with sharing class ContactEmailMatcher {

    public class Request {
        @InvocableVariable(required=true) public String email;
    }

    public class Result {
        @InvocableVariable public Id contactId;
    }

    @InvocableMethod(label='Match Contact by Email')
    public static List<Result> match(List<Request> requests) {
        List<Result> results = new List<Result>();
        if (requests == null || requests.isEmpty()) {
            return results;
        }

        List<String> normalizedEmails = new List<String>();
        Set<String> emailsToQuery = new Set<String>();

        for (Request req : requests) {
            String normalized = null;
            if (req != null && !String.isBlank(req.email)) {
                normalized = req.email.trim().toLowerCase();
                emailsToQuery.add(normalized);
            }
            normalizedEmails.add(normalized);
        }

        Map<String, Id> contactIdByEmail = new Map<String, Id>();
        if (!emailsToQuery.isEmpty()) {
            // Single bulkified query. Ordered so the first contact seen for
            // each normalized email is the earliest created (then lowest Id).
            // SOQL string matching is case-insensitive, so lowercased keys
            // match contacts stored with any casing.
            for (Contact c : [
                SELECT Id, Email
                FROM Contact
                WHERE Email IN :emailsToQuery
                ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC, Id ASC
            ]) {
                if (String.isBlank(c.Email)) {
                    continue;
                }
                String key = c.Email.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (!contactIdByEmail.containsKey(key)) {
                    contactIdByEmail.put(key, c.Id);
                }
            }
        }

        for (String normalized : normalizedEmails) {
            Result res = new Result();
            res.contactId = (normalized == null) ? null : contactIdByEmail.get(normalized);
            results.add(res);
        }
        return results;
    }
}
```
